name: Ore no Yome wa Superheroine ~Tatakatta Power no Kaifuku wa Love Love H...?~
original_name: 俺の嫁はスーパーヒロイン～闘ったパワーの回復はラブラブH…?～
source:
By chance, I managed to win the heart of the prettiest girl in my office and get married...
Then, I found out that she is the warrior of justice, Justy Girl!
She is a super heroine, so she wears clothing which can be called "cosplay."
It's wonderful that she regains the power from the sex with me after the fighting.
But, my dear wife got caught by the enemy and humiliated by tentacles...
I held her tightly who was lying at death's door, hoping that a miracle to happen...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056853.html]DLsite English[/url]]
